### Added
- **`modelServing.fastLinks`: the nodes joined by a fast link (RDMA), published as the discovery ConfigMap's `spec.fastLinks`** (giantswarm/model-manager#190). model-manager splits one model across the nodes of one fast link — one vLLM instance, tensor parallel over the link — and refuses a split across nodes without one; the portal recommends the split where a fast link hosts the model. Per entry: `name`, `nodes` (two or more), the `networks` every pod of a split joins (NetworkAttachmentDefinition names), the extra `resources` it requests (the RDMA device plugin's) and the `env` that points NCCL at the link's devices. Empty, the default, renders no key: the discovery document of an installation without fast links is unchanged. With a fast link declared, a split's leader and workers — the pods of a LeaderWorkerSet — reach each other on every port (network policy `<release>-model-serving-multi-node`); a single-node model pod does not. `make verify-fast-links`.
### Removed
- **The PolicyException `model-serving-fast-links`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37941). model-manager 1.4.2 runs a split's leader and workers with the single-node model pod's security context (giantswarm/model-manager#193): no `IPC_LOCK`, `SYS_RAWIO` or `NET_RAW`, and NCCL over the fast link needs none of them. Nothing requests the capabilities any more, so no pod may add them. `make verify-fast-links` fails if the exception renders.
